content: MARIA JESUS MENUOM

Amu Elisabet nug Layaṯak Johanes menue, haen amu nakok dimp̱a Sarinus nug Siria dilag danab oḵai dayeye amu Kaisa Agastas nug Rom danab ah oh onilag yaaglagnu ḏo meum. Ag onilag awak uḏat amu haen amup̱a dig mep̱ig.
Kaisa nug ḏo me, onilag yaaglagnu ap̱alag diigp̱a uḵaegeg,
Josep nug Dawit buḏub amunu nug Maria ele, a layam daapiḏ amu, a ab oḵai Nasaret, Galelianu ahaya, Juda wanp̱a, ab onig Betlehem, ap̱a onilah meḵulahnu gopiḏ. Maria nug oo ele dayom
amu a ap̱a daaeheh, Marianu nid awak haen do,
nug nid danab tatamnu menuom. Menua, niiak lag am beum amunu nug beḵa lamen elabp̱a ehaḵa, doḏ dilag e lanak taḏaḏ oop̱a me niiom.
SIPSIP GUMAK DANAB AG JESUS DOUMNU DOOP̱IG
Amu tuqan amup̱a Betlehem ab guguiṯak doḏ sipsip gumaṯak danab ag sipsip gumadna daaegeg,
Kayaknu engel gumaṯa ne, Naḏinu amahlak ag taliliaṯa honaḏom. Honaḏe amu ag huanak baḏan heeg,
engel nug amelagp̱a aum. “Ag aib baḏap̱ig. Da oo gamag ahaknu nai ena danab oh dilagnu awe nemi.
Gemu deḏ imup̱a Betlehem abp̱a ah laa nid awom. Nid amu Nug ag eḏua diiadḵu, Nug amu Naḏi, Kristus.
Ag Nug anidḵulagnu ep̱onak keeke amu inam. Nug anig Nug lamen elabp̱a ehaḵa, doḏ dilag e lanak taḏaḏ oop̱a me niiṯe,” awa aum.
Engel nug amelagp̱a ana male, pahanab Kayaknu engel kuḏum neeg, moitan daanna, ahi eṯana ap̱ig.
“Kayak Nug aṯannab daaṯe. Ig Nug binag aṯan humaṯem. Wanp̱anu danab, ag nuhignu daaṯeb amu, ag maḏoḏ maṯom,” aon ap̱ig,
Engel ag anam awona, ag eḏun, hab aṯan teeg amu sipsip gumak danab ag ahan, aḵa aḵa nai inam madip̱ig. “Ig Betlehem gota, kobol Naḏi Nug amenigp̱a aum amu anidtu!”
Anam anana amu ag paha gona, Maria Josep amu nid yuḏ ele, nug doḏ dilag taḏaḏp̱a niieye, anaṯona,
ag eḏun gonana, danab laala amelagp̱a nid amunu nai doop̱ig amu ag mehuqp̱ig.
Mehuqeg doona amu ag oolag oṯaie, ootot ele aqom.
Amge Maria nug nai amu oop̱a me dayeye, dab meṯom.
Anam dayeye amu gumak danab ag oolag gamag ahehe, eḏun gona, ag kobol oh ag amelagp̱a anidna, nai daulagp̱a doop̱ig ele amu, ag amunu Kayak onig binag ele humap̱ig.
JOSEP WAU ELE JESUS AOYA, MANA MEṮAK LAḴA GOPIḎ
Dimp̱a, deḏ eblaih ewamp̱a, ag nid nakok gaḏa otaḏna, ag Nug onig Jesus ataḏp̱ig. Nug anig oop̱a ii dayeye, engel nug onig amu aḵulagnu aum.
Aria ah beḏu babaiṯak daaḵunu, Moses ḏop̱a yom amu, haen amu iiṯa me, Josep wau ele a nid Kayak ep̱egp̱a meḵulahnu Jerusalem tepiḏ.
Kayaknu ḏop̱a ag anam heḵulagnu yak daaṯe. Yak am inam. “Nid danab tatamnu, ag anilḵad menuadp̱eg amu ag diin, Naḏi ep̱egp̱a maadḵulag.”

A anam heḵulahnu teya amu a Maria beḏu babaiṯak daaḵunu mana meṯak amu ele heḵulahnu tepiḏ. Ḏop̱a, amu haknu yak inam daaṯe. “Ag up̱uḏil oḵai aḏit Kayak main meṯaglag o iiṯa up̱uḏil nakok aḏit main meṯeg!”
Haen amup̱a danab laa Jerusalem dayom, nug onig Simon. Nug Kayak noobp̱a tutuḵu oiyaya, Kayak binag ena maama, Israel dilag ehanaṯak danab ameg meum. Kayak Ouḏi Nug ele daapiḏ.
Nug Kayak Ouḏi ele daapiḏ amu Kayak Ouḏi Nug danab amu nug paha ii mauhma, tatam nug Naḏi Kristus aniṯowa amu dimp̱a nug mauhḵunu ip̱uniṯom.
Aria Josep wau ele gopiḏ, deḏ amup̱a Kayak Ouḏi Nug he, Simon nug aha uḵa, mana meṯak lag oop̱a no, anig mameg ele a nid nakok omalya, ḏo aṯe bia heḵulahnu tepiḏ.
Teeh, Simon anata, nug nid awa, ep̱egp̱a aḏa, Kayak binag ma aum.
“O Naḏi, na anuḵa da amelp̱a da nid imu, ihinig ehaniṯak, na danab ah oh anidna dooglagnu me neum ele amu, da anidḵulnu ame amu da gemu iiḵu amelp̱a anidmi amunu da mauhḵul am nai iiṯa.
Nug iiṯa aḏi ag nahip ib anidḵulagnu, Nug Israel ag binalag aoglagnu, amahlak daaṯe,” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu Josep Maria ele a Simon Jesusnu anam maṯie doya, a nai amunu dab mak kuḏum aoeheh,

Simon nug itiṯak matowa, nid anig Maria amegp̱a aum. “Doye, nid imu heeb, Israel danab ah kuḏum ag nena qeḵulag amge heeb, kuḏum ag eḏun ahaglag. Nug amu Kayak anidḵunignu ep̱onak keeke daaḵu amge danab kuḏum nuhignu nai nau aḵulag.
Amunu danab kuḏum dilag dab mak aaḵu miag atiak daaḵu. Amu oo doyak oḵai, qep aegp̱a yak bia, na yaaidḵu,” awa aum.
Aria propet ah laa dayom onig Ana. Nug Asa buḏub, Panuel aḏeg. Anuḵa nug danab awe amu gamu ele maḏ sewenib daapiḏ.
Anam daaiya, nug gamu mauhe, qab ma, hamu maḏ 84 dayaya, nug mana meṯak lag ii uuṯom. Nug Kayak binag meḵunu e laḵunu haen kuḏum kud ma dayaya, unuqiṯaṯa, tuqan amun ele binag maama dayom.
Haen amup̱aib nug ele uḏia, Kayak amegp̱a, “Ena heme,” aum. Anana nug nid amunu nai mehuqa, danab oh Jerusalem daanna, Kayaknu ḏo maḏoḏ ameg mep̱ig ele amu Jesusnu amelagp̱a aum.
Amu a keeke oh Naḏinu ḏo aṯe bia heya malaeh, ag Galelia, ahilag ab oḵaip̱a, Nasaret gop̱ig.
Gona daanna, nid ena ma, doyak ena awa, g̱agatag ele awe, Kayak Nug nuhignu ena doya, Nug ehaniṯom.
JESUS MAḎ TUELP DAYAYA, MANA MEṮAK LAḴA UḴOM
Amu Jesus anig mameg ele a haen oh maḏ ohp̱a meṯid oḵai Pasowa, amuam bret yis iiṯa lanaknu hobul, amup̱a daaglahnu Jerusalem tedapiḏ.
Haen Jesus Nug maḏ nuhig tuelp aria ag meṯid oḵai amunu kobol dim lamidna, Jerusalem tep̱ig.
Dimp̱a Pasowa deḏ amu male, ag eḏun uḵaegeg, Jesus Nug Jerusalem dayom amge Nug mameg anig ele a Nug dayom amu a ii doopiḏ.
A ahilah dab makp̱a, “Nug danab oolagp̱a oiṯe,” ayaya, deḏ laip̱u oiyeh, tueb me, a baeltip̱a mudip̱an lailti oolagp̱a ele nug madipiḏ.
A madip̱iḏ amge a ii anidpiḏ amunu a eḏuya, maṯiya, Jerusalem gopiḏ.
Goya, a Nug maṯieheh, deḏ aḏit uḵe, dimp̱a deḏ ewamp̱a a Nug mana meṯak lag oop̱a dayeye anidpiḏ. Nug Juda dilag ip̱uniṯak danab oolagp̱a dayeye, ag nai maṯiegeg doya, Nug eḏua oḏ madeṯe daap̱ig.
Amu danab oh ag nuhig nai doop̱ig ele amu, ag nuhig doyaknu amu oḏ maknu nob meum amunu ele dab mak kuḏum aop̱ig.
Daaegeg, mameg anig ele a Nug anidya, huanak oṯaiya, anig Nug amegp̱a aum. “O nid dahil, na aḏinu anam he, i inam oiṯep? Na mamen nug da ele i oonih ugnab dayeye, na maṯidmuḏ,” awa aum.
Anam a amu Nug eḏua amelahp̱a inam aum. “A aḏinu ahaya, da matiḏṯep? Da Mamelnu uḏat heḵulnunab daaṯem amu a iite dooṯep?” awa aum.
Ge nai Nug amelahp̱a aum amu a diig ii doopiḏ.
Aria Jesus Nug a ele eḏun, Nasaret gona amu Nug a oḏelah dim lamiṯeṯe, anig nug keeke amu ohnu oop̱a me dayeye, dab maama dayom.
Amu Jesus Nug ena meeme, nuhig doyak ele oḵai meeme, Kayak noobp̱a, danab noolagp̱a ele Nug ena oiya, tuḏiṯa he, enaib doop̱ig.
